== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Offering of Spirit}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Signet of Creation}}
* {{skill icon|Spirit Channeling}} (elite)
* {{skill icon|Spirit Siphon}}

== Notes ==
* The main difference of this skill compared to its related elite counterparts is the fact that it is a [[signet]]. [[Offering of Spirit]] is a [[spell]] which has a faster activation time, grants more energy, and has a shorter recharge (especially if using weapons providing [[HCT]] and [[HSR]]), on top of that it also ensures energy gain even when not within earshot of a spirit. [[Spirit Channeling]] can return much more energy but is an [[enchantment]] and requires investment in [[Spawning Power]].
* [[Spirit Siphon]] in particular, but also [[Signet of Creation]] and [[Boon of Creation]] (both in Spawning Power) are good, non-elite alternatives if your build uses several spirits.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Signet of Spirits/Skill history|PvE]] and [[Signet of Spirits (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill revision history for details.
